picks.headline: ABYZOR Genesis adds a free local AI module for unlimited MIDI generation
picks.excerpt: ABYZOR released a free local AI module for its Genesis MIDI generator plugin (macOS/Windows), generating melodies, basslines, chord progressions and arpeggios on-device that you edit and drag into your DAW.
picks.rationale: The most actionable pick. It is a free, on-device AI MIDI generator that producers can install today, and it is new to the brief.

picks.headline: Suno Studio demo: record your voice and turn it into any instrument
picks.excerpt: Suno demos a Suno Studio workflow: record your own voice and transform it into other instruments, electric guitar being 'just the start'.
picks.rationale: A new voice-to-instrument workflow from the leading AI music platform. It is the only Suno-owned YouTube item, and it differs from the 9/25 Studio timeline-recording card and the 8/14 Studio 2.0 card.

picks.headline: Japanese voice actor sues TikTok over AI voice cloning
picks.excerpt: A Japanese actor and anime voice talent, possibly the first in Japan to take a major platform to court over AI voice clones, has sued TikTok over videos allegedly using an AI clone of his voice.
picks.rationale: This may be a first in Japan: a professional voice performer taking a platform to court over AI clones of his voice. It is not a duplicate of the 8/30 UK voice-cloning campaign card.

picks.headline: Songs generated in 10 seconds: AI fakes threaten K-pop's authenticity
picks.excerpt: Korean column on how prompt-to-song generators like Suno and Udio are reshaping creation and distribution, and how K-pop agencies' bets on virtual artists and AI vocal tech are colliding with fans who reject AI-polished singers.
picks.rationale: A genuine AI x music story with a Korean K-pop angle the section rarely gets. It covers agencies' virtual-artist and AI-vocal bets running into fan pushback. It is not in published_urls, and no prior music card covers K-pop AI authenticity (the 9/22 KOMCA registration card is a different story).

picks.headline: ElevenLabs' v4 speech model adds finer expression control and 90 languages
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs launched Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo, its most expressive speech models, with finer expression control, 90 languages and voice cloning from a 10-second clip.
picks.rationale: A major AI voice-model launch from a credible outlet. Its 10-second voice cloning ties directly to the voice-performer story at #3. It was kept over Synthtopia Backgrounds because it is a real generative AI model, while Backgrounds is retrieval-only and never says 'AI'. The only other fresh candidates are Suno-owned, excluded, or duplicates.
